metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2026 · Scarpetta
metas.description: A brilliant forensic pathologist uses forensic technology to solve crimes.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · We Were Liars
metas.description: A 17 year-old girl from a wealthy family, Cady Sinclair, spends her summers on a private island. After suffering a terrible accident, she struggles to remember events from her increasingly frightening past.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Sterling Point
metas.description: Annie and her twin brother, raised in NYC by their single father, discover their estranged grandfather bequeathed them a lake island.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · Lazarus
metas.description: After experiencing a personal loss, Lazarus begins having disturbing experiences that can't be explained.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Khauf
metas.description: Madhu moves into a hostel in Delhi to start afresh, but her room hides a sinister presence that begins to get stronger each day, alarming the other women on her floor. They know what the room hides and desperately want her gone before it is too late for them all.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · Scars of Beauty
metas.description: Two families, two terrible injustices, and one common plan for revenge. A daughter who loses her mother is wrongly imprisoned and murdered in prison. A mother who loses her daughter is the victim of medical malpractice. Both join forces to take revenge on those who destroyed their families.
